fusions.name: Hew the Front Row
fusions.desc: Chops the shield's honed rim through an arc 3 tiles ahead, dealing 11 damage to everything in it and leaving it [Bleeding] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Headsman's Drop
fusions.desc: Drops the shield's edge on a failing enemy, which deals 22 damage and splits its armour, leaving it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Notched Boss
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and each attacker is left [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Weighted Edge
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage.
